messages:
jin: Heads up — Lattice17b (int4 hybrid) canary started OOMing on p2-cluster around 10:12 UTC. Mem usage and fragmentation spikes when we hit batch=8 + max_new_tokens=256. Repro locally with the same config.

maria: Can you paste the run logs and the model config?

jin: Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-22 10:12:34] ERROR OOM: Allocation failed for new KV slot (size=512MB)
[2026-03-22 10:12:34] WARN KV-EVICT: evicted 1 slots to free 512MB, frag=0.73
[2026-03-22 10:12:34] ERROR runtime: failed to reserve contiguous slab: no segment >= 384MB
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```

sam: Hmm looks like prefetch was enabled for this canary? Hybrid int4 kernels + aggressive prefetching gave us similar fragmentation on A10080 before. What's the canary config?

jin: Config (redacted):
```yaml
model: lattice17b
quant: int4-hybrid
batch: 8
max_new_tokens: 256
prefetch: true
soft_evict_threshold: 0.8
```

alex: Quick suggestions: disable prefetch for the int4 hybrid path (prefetch=false) and reduce batch to 4. Also lower default max_new_tokens to 128 while we stabilize. Consider soft_evict_threshold=0.7 to force earlier compaction.

maria: Anecdotally we saw fragmentation when batch >6 with int4 on the A10080 node family. The slot compactor patch (internal PR p1234) helped a lot — it coalesces small free segments during low load windows. Can we apply it to the canary?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary lattice17b/int4-0.1 - rollback initiated due to oom_rate > 5% over last 1m :warning:

sam: I'll spin another canary with: prefetch=false, batch=4, max_new_tokens=128, soft_evict_threshold=0.7, and enable the p1234 compactor. Running now.

jin: Please also run the quant quality eval against the float32 baseline. We saw a small factuality dip on a few QA prompts in manual tests. Want to avoid shipping a regression.

alex: Run eval set `l17b_regressions_v1` (200 prompts, mix of QA/dialogue/code). Compare accuracy/f1 and perplexity against baseline. Acceptance heuristic: <2% accuracy drop and <3% perplexity delta, otherwise hold.

maria: I'll add a Console alert: oom_rate > 2% OR p99_latency > 200ms for model:lattice17b triggers a paging alert and creates an incident channel automatically.

jin: Thanks. After the new canary run (no prefetch + compactor) if stable for 1h at 0% OOM rate we can promote. Also plan: run a longer soak with mixed prompt lengths (16/128/256) to surface fragmentation patterns.

sam: Update: canary started at 10:34 UTC with new params. First pass looks promising — no OOMs in 10m, p99 down ~30ms. Will post full results in 20m. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary lattice17b/int4-0.2 deployed to pool p2-canary-3 at 2026-03-22T10:34:12Z

maria: Nice. If we still see small quality drift on the eval, consider re-running quantization with calibrated per-channel scales (recalibration v2) before promoting to dedicated.

jin: Agreed. Keeping this thread for the soak/quality results.
